title: SIT-UP
headline: Posture awareness for everyday work
summary: SIT-UP uses front- and side-camera posture signals to log seated posture and prototype interventions such as audio, vibration, and desk-adjustment prompts. The project connects MediaPipe-based sensing with questionnaire, logging, and intervention-analysis artifacts.
problem: Everyday seated posture changes over time, but workstation interventions need observable posture signals and feedback records before they can be evaluated.
contribution: Front- and side-camera posture pipelines that compute posture signals, log measurements, and support prototypes for audio, vibration, and desk-adjustment prompts.
pipeline: Extract MediaPipe posture landmarks and scoring signals.
Log posture measurements for later analysis.
Prototype and study several intervention modalities.
evidence: Public project video and intervention figures.
limitations: SIT-UP is a human-computer interaction research prototype, not a medical device or a clinical assessment tool.
